Pose - Injured but Standing.name: Pose - Injured but Standing
Pose - Injured but Standing.description:
🕴️ Pose: Injured but Standing
Upright despite visible injury — wounded, strained, but refusing to fall. Determination through pain.

🖼️ Portrait only: changes how your character looks, never your Quirk or stats.
Pose - Injured but Standing.traitNarrativeEffects:
Portrait: Within the selected Portrait Framing, use an uneven upright posture with one shoulder lower and weight favoring one side. Add visible injury, torn clothing, blood, scuffing, or fatigue only when another selected visual trait or player-written visual detail explicitly supports it; otherwise show strain through posture alone. Female: the dropped shoulder pulls the line down, weight off one hip. Male: the dropped shoulder still holds square, weight off one leg. Otherwise (a Mutant body plan): the character's own injured stance.

Visual selection only: keep the character's actual adult age, body plan and any Mutant features; never change anatomy to fit this choice. It adds no Quirk effect, injury, item, license or affiliation.
